title: Aksomati Prime
extract:
The Aksomati Prime are the Primed variant of the  Aksomati dual machine-pistols, with slightly enhanced Damage, and enhanced Status Chance, Fire Rate, and Magazine Size, and has increased Accuracy during spool-up despite its base Accuracy being lowered, and lowered Zoom. Aksomati Prime was released alongside  Ivara Prime and  Baza Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Fully Spooled (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (24.00%)
Above average sustained DPS (319.93)
Very high magazine size (80)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Above average reload speed (1.40 s)
Very high ammo max (880)
Very high fire rate (13.33 attacks/sec)
Very high crit multiplier (3.00x)
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Fully Spooled (wiki attack index 1)
Low damage per shot (29.6)
Very low total damage (20)
Low accuracy (0.00° to 16.00°)
Below average status chance (18.00%)
Low disposition (●●●○○ (1.05x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On December 10th, 2021, it was announced that Aksomati Prime, along with  Ivara Prime and  Baza Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on December 15th, 2021. Any preexisting components or fully-built items will remain as is.

Trivia
The Aksomati Prime, alongside  Afuris Prime,  Akbolto Prime,  Akstiletto Prime,  Ballistica Prime,  Cernos Prime,  Dual Kamas Prime,  Dual Keres Prime,  Fang Prime,  Gunsen Prime,  Paris Prime and  Zhuge Prime are the only Prime weapons that do not require Orokin Cells as crafting ingredients.
